# MGID: Native Performance & Programmatic Advertising Platform

## About
Our vision is to nurture a new stage of digital media, enabling consumers to engage with content and sponsored advertisements in an equally positive way.

## Company Overview
- [Our Company](https://www.mgid.com/about#our-mission): An introduction to MGID, detailing its mission and vision in the digital advertising landscape.
- [Our Team](https://www.mgid.com/about#team): Information about the team behind MGID, highlighting their expertise and roles.
- [Locations](https://www.mgid.com/about#locations): A list of MGID's operational locations around the globe.
- [Careers](https://mgid.recruitee.com/): Current job openings and career opportunities at MGID.
- [Press](https://www.mgid.com/blog/category/press): Access to press releases and media coverage related to MGID.

## Services
- native advertising
- performance advertising
- affiliate marketing
- programmatic advertising
- brand awareness  
- ai digital marketing tools
- ai powered ads
- ai targeted advertising

## Advertising Solutions
- [Advertisers](https://www.mgid.com/advertisers): A comprehensive overview of the advertising solutions offered by MGID for advertisers.
- [Advertisers TOS](https://www.mgid.com/services/advertisers-tos): Terms of service specifically for advertisers using MGID's platform.
- [MGID | Native Ads Platform for Advertisers](https://lp.mgid.com/): Detailed information on MGID's native advertising platform tailored for advertisers.

## Publisher Solutions
- [Publishers](https://www.mgid.com/publishers): Insights into how publishers can benefit from MGID's services and tools.

## Educational Resources
- [MGID Academy](https://www.facebook.com/mgid.academy): A resource for learning about digital advertising and MGID's offerings.
- [Knowledge Base](https://help.mgid.com/): A collection of articles and guides to help users understand MGID's platform and services.

## Events and Webinars
- [Webinars](https://app.livestorm.co/mgid-1): Information on upcoming webinars hosted by MGID to educate users on various topics.
- [Affiliate Summit East 2025](https://www.mgid.com/events/affiliate-summit-east-2025): Details about MGID's participation in the Affiliate Summit East event.
- [Affiliate World Europe 2025](https://www.mgid.com/events/affiliate-world-europe-2025): Information on MGID's involvement in the Affiliate World Europe event.
- [Digital Marketing Expo & Conference - DMEXCO 2025](https://www.mgid.com/events/digital-marketing-expo-and-conference-dmexco-2025): Overview of MGID's presence at the DMEXCO conference.
- [MGID events | Livestorm](https://social.mgid.com/YscToWpj): A platform for attending MGID's live events and webinars.

## Insights and Articles
- [What is an Ad Exchange? Understanding the Core of Programmatic Ad Trading](https://www.mgid.com/blog/what-is-an-ad-exchange): An informative article explaining the fundamentals of ad exchanges and programmatic trading.
- [MGID's Approach to DEI: Building a Culture of Belonging](https://www.mgid.com/blog/mgid-s-approach-to-dei-building-a-culture-of-belonging): Insights into MGID's diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
- [Data Management Platforms: Turning Clicks into Connections](https://www.mgid.com/blog/data-management-platforms): An exploration of data management platforms and their role in digital advertising.
- [RTB for Humans: A Quick Guide to Smarter Bidding](https://www.mgid.com/blog/rtb-meaning): A guide to real-time bidding strategies in digital advertising.
- [Third-Party Cookies and The State of Digital Advertising](https://social.mgid.com/A0aPmd2N): An analysis of the impact of third-party cookies on the digital advertising landscape.
- [Debunking the Myths of Native Advertising - MediaNews4U](https://social.mgid.com/ueWQ52e0): An article addressing common misconceptions about native advertising.
- [Cutting through clickbait to the true meaning of native - WARC](https://social.mgid.com/a7goZaRC): A discussion on the essence of native advertising beyond clickbait tactics.
- [Contextual Intelligence is the Future of Targeting - Agency Reporter](https://social.mgid.com/_lxQaveX): Insights into the future of advertising targeting through contextual intelligence.

## Industry Trends
- [Marketing Spend Has Fallen, But There's Room for Optimism](https://social.mgid.com/XamNtCOE): An analysis of current trends in marketing spend and future outlooks.
- [Is contextual targeting the solution to brand-safe advertising?](https://social.mgid.com/RAVwxzxB): A discussion on the effectiveness of contextual targeting in ensuring brand safety.
- [Decoding the brand safety conundrum - afaqs!](https://social.mgid.com/14f0fqYl): An exploration of the challenges and solutions related to brand safety in advertising.
- [What does Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act mean for digital ...](https://social.mgid.com/i8gL6wmk): An overview of the implications of Thailand's data protection laws on digital advertising.
- [CCPA: An Explainer For Digital Publishers](https://social.mgid.com/C7mEw0dF): A guide for digital publishers on the California Consumer Privacy Act and its impact.

## Additional Resources
- [Ad Gallery](https://ad-gallery.mgid.com/): A showcase of various advertisements created using MGID's platform.
- [MGID Status](https://status.mgid.com/): Real-time updates on the operational status of MGID's services.
- [MGID Talks India. Paridhi Khaitan - YouTube](https://social.mgid.com/0kfioXcE): A video discussion featuring insights from MGID's representatives.
- [Traffic Diversification Needs A Performance-Based Approach](https://social.mgid.com/km7HBQKd): An article discussing the importance of performance-based strategies in traffic diversification.
- [Exposed: The Users Behind the Ad Blockers - ExchangeWire.com](https://social.mgid.com/eDcQiynd): An investigation into the demographics and motivations of ad blocker users.
- [MGID - Native advertising platform](https://www.mgid.com/uk): Information about MGID's native advertising platform in Ukrainian.

## Conclusion
- [2024 in Review](https://2024-review-year.mgid.com/): A retrospective look at MGID's achievements and developments over the past year.
- [Join MGID's referral program and get 5% commission](https://lp.mgid.com/referrals): Details on how to participate in MGID's referral program.
